nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Every color is a semantic token referencing a CSS variable. Never hardcode hex or oklch in a component. This enables dark mode without a single .dark override in component code.

nodes.label: The One Voice Rule
nodes.rationale: The accent color is used on primary actions, current selection, and focus indicators only. It never decorates. Its rarity on the page is what makes it signal.

nodes.label: The Data Speaks Mono Rule
nodes.rationale: Every dollar amount, every gram, every percentage renders in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums enabled. The font shift signals this is data, not prose.

nodes.label: La Cocina Ordenada
nodes.rationale: A professional kitchen at mise-en-place: every ingredient weighed, every tool in reach, every surface clean. Trades decoration for clarity, but never at the cost of warmth.

nodes.label: Recipe Categories Plan
nodes.rationale: Free text TEXT column on recipes, same pattern as brand/supplier in ingredients. No separate categories table to minimize complexity.

nodes.label: Recipe Instructions Plan
nodes.rationale: Single TEXT field with Markdown rendering via marked. No separate recipe_steps table in v1 to minimize schema changes.

nodes.label: Token Bridge Rule
nodes.rationale: NON-NEGOTIABLE — Token Bridge Rule. No exceptions. Replace all hardcoded theme-specific values with semantic tokens. Violations found in CTASection, FeaturesSection, HowItWorksSection, PricingSection.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast Compliance
nodes.rationale: Non-negotiable for public-facing website. Darken text-subtle-foreground from #94a3b8 to meet 4.5:1 minimum. Verify all accent-relevant contrast pairs in dark mode.

nodes.label: Dual Image to Single Image Refactor
nodes.rationale: Reduce payload ~50%, respects manual theme toggle (not OS-level prefers-color-scheme). Rejected <picture> because app uses manual .dark class toggle, not OS media query.
nodes.norm_label: dual image to single image refactor

nodes.label: Responsive Breakpoint Coverage
nodes.rationale: Missing xl/2xl breakpoints. Content capped at max-w-7xl but interior grids stretched on >1440px. Add xl/2xl responsive adjustments without container queries (scope constraint).

nodes.label: Google Font Subsetting
nodes.rationale: Reduce font payload ~40%. Subset Outfit to wght@400;600;700 and JetBrains Mono to wght@400;500 from current 7+5 weights (~300-400KB).

nodes.label: Lighthouse Performance Target
nodes.rationale: >80 mobile, >90 desktop Lighthouse score. <3s 4G load time. CLS <0.1. Current implementation likely fails mobile due to dual images and CLS.

nodes.label: Constitution Gate Checks
nodes.rationale: G1-G8 gates must pass before implementation. Includes Token Bridge, Theme Triad, Independence, WCAG, Optimistic Updates, CSRF, Flash Prevention, TypeScript Strict.

nodes.label: Flash Prevention Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Inline blocking <script is:inline> in Layout.astro reads matchMedia before first paint. Already proven pattern in LandingLayout.astrolines 49-54.

nodes.label: Accent Color Independence
nodes.rationale: Constitution Independence Rule — theme and accent are separate controls. Changing one does not affect the other. Existing JS already separates updateThemeOptions and updateAccentOptions.

nodes.label: System Theme Preference
nodes.rationale: System should read theme from user device configuration. Seamless out-of-box experience. New default for users with no saved preference.

nodes.label: Optimistic Theme Update
nodes.rationale: Apply immediately client-side, revert to previous state and show error notification on server failure. Matches constitution optimistic update pattern.
